gloss: medicine taken as needed; on-demand medication

definitions.gloss: medicine taken as needed; on-demand medication
definitions.explanation: Medication that is taken only when symptoms arise, rather than on a regular schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頓服薬|とんぷくやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I take the as-needed medication when I'm in pain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頓服薬|とんぷくやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The doctor gave me some medication to take as needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{頓服薬|とんぷくやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This as-needed medication can be taken up to three times a day.

notes:
⟦{頓服|とんぷく}→頓服：18471_tonpuku⟧ by itself means taking medicine on an as-needed basis, and {頓服薬|とんぷくやく} specifies the medication itself. Common examples include painkillers, sleep aids, and anti-anxiety medication. In medical contexts, this corresponds to the abbreviation PRN (pro re nata, Latin for "as the situation arises").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{頓服|とんぷく}→頓服：18471_tonpuku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ — to take (medicine) on an as-needed basis
- ⟦{頓服|とんぷく}→頓服：18471_tonpuku⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧ — as-needed prescription
- ⟦{痛|いた}み{止|ど}め→痛み止め：23497_itamidome⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頓服薬|とんぷくやく} — painkiller for as-needed use

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{常用薬|じょうようやく}→常用薬：25994_jouyouyaku⟧ — regularly taken medicine (the opposite: medicine taken on a fixed schedule)

- ⟦{処方薬|しょほうやく}→処方薬：18860_shohouyaku⟧ — prescription medicine
